foster creativity: Art and music classes can foster creativity in children by encouraging them to try new ideas without fear of mistakes.
美術和音樂課能鼓勵孩子嘗試新點子而不怕犯錯，藉此培養他們的創造力。
foster good relations: Sports events between the two cities help foster good relations and bring their young people closer together.
兩座城市之間的體育賽事有助於促進良好關係，並拉近雙方年輕人的距離。
foster a child: The kind couple signed up with a social worker to foster a child whose parents could not take care of him.
這對善良的夫婦向社工登記，寄養一個父母無法照顧的小孩。
foster growth: The government lowered taxes for small businesses in order to foster growth in the local economy.
政府為小型企業減稅，以促進地方經濟成長。
foster understanding: Learning about other cultures can foster understanding between people and reduce the fear of things that seem strange.
了解其他文化能增進人與人之間的理解，並減少對陌生事物的恐懼。
foul the water: Factories that dump their waste into the river foul the water and kill thousands of fish every year.
把廢棄物傾倒進河裡的工廠弄髒了水，每年害死成千上萬條魚。
foul up the plan: We had prepared everything for the surprise party, but my little brother told Mom and fouled up the plan.
我們已經把驚喜派對都準備好了，但我弟弟告訴了媽媽，搞砸了計畫。
fall foul of the law: Drivers who keep using their phones while driving will soon fall foul of the law and have to pay heavy fines.
開車時一直使用手機的駕駛人很快就會觸法，並被處以高額罰款。
cry foul: When the referee ignored the obvious handball, the players and fans began to cry foul and demanded a penalty.
裁判忽視那個明顯的手球犯規時，球員和球迷開始抗議不公，要求判罰十二碼球。
found a company: After working for other people for ten years, my aunt decided to found a company that sells healthy snacks.
替別人工作十年後，我阿姨決定創辦一家販售健康零食的公司。
be founded on trust: A true friendship should be founded on trust, so you should never lie to the people who care about you.
真正的友誼應該以信任為基礎，所以你絕不該對關心你的人說謊。
found a school: In 1882, a Canadian missionary helped found a school in northern Taiwan to give local children an education.
1882年，一位加拿大傳教士協助在台灣北部建校，讓當地孩子得以受教育。
well-founded: Her worries about the old bridge turned out to be well-founded when it fell into the river during the typhoon.
她對那座老橋的擔憂結果是有根據的，因為它在颱風期間坍塌落入河中。
frame a question: Before the interview, the student reporter practiced how to frame a question politely so the mayor would answer it.
訪問前，學生記者練習如何有禮貌地提出問題，好讓市長願意回答。
frame a policy: The government invited young people to help frame a policy that would make housing cheaper in big cities.
政府邀請年輕人協助制定一項讓大城市住房更便宜的政策。
be framed for murder: In the movie, an innocent man is framed for murder and spends years in prison before the truth comes out.
在這部電影裡，一名無辜男子被誣陷謀殺，在真相大白前坐了好幾年牢。
frame the debate: The host framed the debate around one simple question: should students be allowed to use phones in class?
主持人將這場辯論的框架設定在一個簡單的問題上：學生是否應獲准在課堂上使用手機？
frame of mind: After a good night's sleep and a big breakfast, I was in a much better frame of mind for the exam.
睡了一夜好覺又吃了頓豐盛早餐後，我以好得多的心境去應考。
free the hostages: The police stormed the bank and managed to free the hostages without anyone getting hurt.
警方攻入銀行，成功釋放人質，沒有任何人受傷。
free up time: Cooking meals for the whole week on Sunday helps me free up time for homework and exercise on weekdays.
星期天先煮好一整週的飯菜，幫我在平日騰出時間寫作業和運動。
free oneself from debt: It took him five years of working two jobs to free himself from debt after his business failed.
生意失敗後，他兼兩份工作花了五年才擺脫債務。
free speech: In a democracy, free speech allows people to criticize the government without being afraid of going to prison.
在民主國家，言論自由讓人民能批評政府而不必害怕坐牢。
freeze prices: To help families during the hard times, the government ordered stores to freeze prices on rice and cooking oil.
為了在困難時期幫助家庭，政府下令商店凍結米和食用油的價格。
freeze assets: The court decided to freeze assets belonging to the businessman, so he could not move any money out of the country.
法院決定凍結這位商人的資產，讓他無法把任何錢轉出國外。
freeze in fear: The moment a big dog barks at my little sister, she freezes in fear like a statue and cannot move.
大狗一對我妹妹吠叫，她就像雕像一樣嚇呆，動彈不得。
freeze hiring: Because sales dropped sharply this year, the company decided to freeze hiring until the economy gets better.
由於今年銷售量大幅下滑，公司決定凍結招聘，直到經濟好轉為止。
freeze someone out: The other girls tried to freeze her out by ignoring her messages and never inviting her to lunch.
其他女生不回她訊息、從不約她吃午餐，試圖排擠她。
frequent a café: Many college students frequent a café near the campus because it has free Wi-Fi and comfortable seats.
許多大學生常去校園附近的一家咖啡店，因為那裡有免費無線網路和舒適的座位。
frequent the library: Students who frequent the library before exams often find it hard to get a seat after nine in the morning.
考前常泡圖書館的學生，往往發現早上九點後就很難找到座位。
frequented by tourists: This night market is frequented by tourists, so many stalls there print their menus in English, Japanese, and Korean.
這座夜市觀光客常去，所以那裡許多攤位都印有英、日、韓文菜單。
